name: finance-desktop-macos
author: Nik
description: macOS desktop wrapper for the finance app

scripts.build:web: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('../.next/build',{recursive:true,force:true})" && npm --prefix .. run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src=path.resolve(process.cwd(),'../.next/standalone');const dst=path.resolve(process.cwd(),'webapp');if(!fs.existsSync(src)){throw new Error('Missing standalone build at '+src);}fs.rmSync(dst,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true});fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true});"
